description:
## Why

Policy shift (2026-05-11): no work is gated by version milestone. We drive to full RFC 5280 + adjacent-RFC coverage. The 'v0.1 deliverable' framing in AGENTS.md and the scattered '(tracked for v0.2)' / 'deferred to v0.3' comments are retired.

## Three categories of 'out of scope' language in the repo

(Settled in chat 2026-05-11 with Mark.)

- **Category A** — version-gating ("out of scope for v0.1", "tracked for v0.2", "planned for v0.3"). KILL these everywhere except CHANGELOG history and `specs/` (vendored upstream).
- **Category B** — crate-level work-partition ("X is out of scope for THIS CRATE — see pkix-Y"). KEEP. Load-bearing architecture documentation.
- **Category C** — `# Limitations` rustdoc sections describing current shipped behavior. KEEP. Truthful user-facing disclosures; shrink when the underlying code lands the feature, not by editorial fiat.

## Magnitude (from grep 2026-05-11)

- 27 literal "out of scope" matches in repo (mixed A/B; ~13 are Category A).
- 50 v0.x version-gating matches (nearly all Category A).
- 24 `# Limitations` rustdoc sections (all Category C, keep).
- ≥2 beads with v0.x in title; ≥2 deferred-status beads with Category-A reasons.

## Acceptance

- [ ] AGENTS.md has no Category-A language and no 'v0.1 deliverable' section.
- [ ] No repository file outside `specs/` and CHANGELOG.md history contains '(tracked for v0.x)', 'deferred to v0.x', 'planned for v0.x', or 'out of scope for v0.x'.
- [ ] All Category-A deferred-status beads either re-opened or re-justified on non-version-gate grounds.
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry recording the policy shift with date.
- [ ] PKIX-t0w4 reframed: with the v0.1 path-building gate dropped, the default option becomes 'use pkix-path-builder' (which already exists as a crate).

## Out of this epic's scope

(Category B language, used correctly!)

- Actually implementing the deferred features (DSA, NameConstraints expansion, Unicode NFKC in names_match, etc.). Those have their own beads which become workable after this sweep lands.
- Editing `specs/*` (vendored RFC + CABF BR text).
- Rewriting historical CHANGELOG entries.

## Children

- AGENTS.md + CHANGELOG anchor (`.1`)
- Code/docs sweep across affected crates (`.2`)
- Bead description + deferred-status sweep (`.3`)
title: Drop v0.x milestone gating; commit to full RFC scope
